description: Defines the DocumentObjectDescriptor class, which serves as a value descriptor for classes derived from DocumentObject within the MigraDoc library. It provides methods to get, set, nullify, and check null status of DocumentObject instances via reflection.

classes.name: DocumentObjectDescriptor
classes.description: A class that describes the value of properties in classes derived from DocumentObject, allowing for reflection-based operations such as get, set, nullify, and null checks.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of the property from a DocumentObject, creating and assigning a new value if necessary and allowed.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets the value of the property on a DocumentObject.

methods.name: SetNull
methods.description: Sets the property value on a DocumentObject to null.

methods.name: IsNull
methods.description: Checks whether the property in a DocumentObject is null or set to null.
